name: resend
description: Simulates the Resend email API: single and batch sends with idempotency keys and scheduling (reschedule and cancel), reading and listing emails with cursor pagination, test-address outcomes, domains (create, read, update, verify, delete), API keys (create, list, rename, delete, sending_access and domain-bound), webhooks (register, read, update, delete) with Svix-signed delivery of email and domain events, and the audiences, audience contacts and broadcasts routes the SDKs call.
